title: VIP.com Launches Self-Developed AI Assistant AI Xiao Wei, Entering the Stage of Deepening AI Shopping Consultant Capabilities

content_html:
According to Sina Technology, Vipshop has recently launched its self-developed AI assistant "AI Xiaowei," developed by Vipshop's large model team. It supports text and voice interaction, providing services such as product search, event inquiry, and discount consultation, further integrating the capabilities of large models into the e-commerce guidance scenario.

At the same time, Vipshop is increasing its efforts in hiring talent for large models. Recruitment platform information shows that the company is currently recruiting for key positions such as Large Model Post-Training Director, LLM Data Integration Director, and Large Model SFT Text Data Director, with monthly salaries ranging from 50,000 to 80,000 yuan, corresponding to an annual salary of 600,000 to 960,000 yuan.

It is reported that these positions will focus on building the capabilities of "AI Xiaowei," covering modules such as guidance intent recognition, product understanding, recommendation generation, and multi-turn dialogue. By defining data requirements for each capability, building corresponding datasets, continuously diagnosing model shortcomings, and iterating and optimizing, the service capabilities of the assistant will be improved.

From product launch to core talent deployment, Vipshop is promoting the integration of large models with e-commerce business. How to improve product matching, personalized recommendations, and dialogue interaction through model training will become a key factor in whether the AI assistant can enhance the shopping experience.
